summary: Complete teamwork project prompt for Human Script DNA extraction. Phase 1: Transcribe 9 competitor audio files via Groq Whisper API. Phase 2: Deep multi-dimensional analysis covering 8 dimensions — hooks, source citations, narrative bridges, emotional pacing, anti-slop markers, PLUS 3 additional dimensions not in original README: segment architecture, vocabulary fingerprinting, and retention/open-loop mechanics. Phase 3: Cross-channel convergence analysis to separate universal human script DNA from channel-specific style. Phase 4: Build reusable Script DNA Template with anti-slop checklist and humanizer integration. Includes acceptance criteria and verification plan.
